title: ARS QC Pre-flight Agent — Input (production-tier convergence)
description: Validates the v1.0 input of the QC Pre-flight Agent (Agent #7 of 17). Authored Day 45 (Wed Jun 3 2026) from SPEC §2 Inputs (Day 40 outline) + §2.1 primary input (replicated_shots, any mode) + §2.2 Mode B forensic cross-check (rendered_shots) + §2.3 accumulated_qc_pre_flags surface + §2.4 lever/tier context + §16 metadata block (Day 43). QC Pre-flight is mode-agnostic: production_mode is read for context/reporting, not for verdict forking. The polymorphic predecessor success/error discrimination is the upstream output_type — but QC Pre-flight CANNOT QC a failed input, so this schema requires the success shape on the consumed branch; an inbound errorEnvelope is a runtime halt (upstream_not_success), not a schema-valid input. parent_chain inbound = Style Replication 5-tuple (LOCKED canon, ARS-2026-05-22-Style-Replication-output.schema.json parentChain5Tuple, inherited verbatim positions 0-4). Deep replicated_shots / rendered_shots internals are validated by their own LOCKED producer schemas (read-only); this schema constrains the QC-relevant envelope + the fields QC Pre-flight adjudicates, and leaves deep producer internals permissive to avoid canon drift (single-file, no external $ref resolution).

replicated_shots.description: Style Replication output.schema.json successReplicatedShots branch (primary input, any mode). Deep internals enforced by the LOCKED producer schema; QC-relevant per-shot fields constrained here.

production_plan.description: Denormalized ProdCoord output carried for format-spec + tier + platform_variants. platform_variants[] is the format-spec target set (§2.1 hard validation 6).

platform_variants.description: Non-empty per §2.1 validation 6. Each variant is the aspect/duration/caption-burn target adjudicated in Step 5.

cost_ledger.description: Per-agent actual spend + combined tier ceiling. QC Pre-flight is the first agent with total-spend visibility (Step 7 cost_ledger_check). cumulative = ai_video_gen + style_replication + self-cost.

tier_combined_ceiling_usd.description: Combined tier ceiling (§4 / §7.3): <=40 Pilot-Starter Mode A · 450 Pro ($400+$50) · 870 Enterprise ($750+$120). Inherited verbatim from Style Replication §7.3 reconciliation.

accumulated_qc_pre_flags.description: §2.3 — the defining input. Union of qc_pre_flags[] from all 6 upstream agents. Each agent MUST contribute >=4 snake_case predicates (Cross-SPEC §3.4 floor). A short array from any stage => qc_pre_flags_floor_breach at runtime (Step 3 adjudication).

rendered_shots.description: OPTIONAL — Mode B forensic cross-check only (§2.2). AI Video Gen output.schema.json successRenderedShots branch. Present => verify negative_prompt_sha256 survived the Style Replication passthrough (Step 9). Absent in Mode A / Mode C.

negative_prompt_sha256.description: OPTIONAL — Mode B only. The forensic invariant cross-checked against the value carried on rendered_shots (Step 9 lineage_integrity_failure on mismatch).

replicatedShotConsumed.description: QC-relevant projection of a Style Replication replicated_shot. Deep internals validated by the producer schema (read-only); QC reads asset_uri (ars:// platform-relative — Hard Rule #8), qc_pre_flags floor, and drift_warning_bool (Step 8 reconciliation).

asset_uri.description: Platform-relative ars:// pattern (Hard Rule #8 inherit — NO absolute URLs). §2.1 validation 2.

renderedShotConsumed.description: QC-relevant projection of an AI Video Gen rendered_shot (Mode B forensic). All rendered_shots[] share one negative_prompt_sha256 (Day 22 §6 Check #10 forensic invariant).

platformVariant.description: A target platform render spec. QC Pre-flight checks aspect / duration / caption-burn parity per variant (Step 5).

qcPreFlagsArray.description: Cross-SPEC §3.4 minItems-4 floor + §3.7 snake_case predicate shape. Adjudicated, not re-executed, by Step 3.

sessionId.description: Inbound session identifier. Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible — does not false-reject existing pipeline session ids). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

inboundParentChain5Tuple.description: Inbound lineage = Style Replication 5-tuple (LOCKED canon — ARS-2026-05-22-Style-Replication-output.schema.json parentChain5Tuple, positions 0-4 inherited verbatim). QC Pre-flight validates this is a well-formed 5-tuple inbound (§2.1 validation 4); a malformed inbound chain => lineage_integrity_failure at runtime. QC appends its own preflight_report_id at position 5 on OUTPUT (held at minItems-5 until Cross-SPEC §3.9 ratifies — see output.schema.json).

inboundMetadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 inbound metadata carried from Style Replication. QC Pre-flight reads tier / production_mode / lever_state / parent_chain (5-tuple) / brand_id for context + the 7th-pass tier-mode re-validation.

tier.description: Universal — all 4 tiers traverse the gate (§4 / Decision #2). Safety is not a tier feature.
